objective: Add bounded, seeded, dependency-free property suites for event ordering, schema validation, policy rejection, frame decoding and state transitions, and a mutation gate that proves each fail-closed rejection and threshold is load-bearing by neutering it inside an ephemeral sandbox copy, requiring the named tests to fail, and leaving the repository byte-identical. Archive seeds, generator version, case counts and shrunk counterexamples as machine-readable summaries, quarantine flaky tests with an owner and expiry instead of retrying them, and publish the summary from a scheduled workflow.
decision_supported: Can a reviewer see, from a machine-readable summary alone, which seeded cases ran for each fail-closed boundary, that neutering a specific rejection or threshold was actually detected by a named test, that nothing was retried or silently skipped, and that the repository itself was never modified by the probes?
acceptance: seeded, dependency-free property suites cover event ordering, schema validation, policy rejection, frame decoding and state transitions, and each suite runs the same case corpus for the same seed on every host
a failing case is shrunk before it is reported, and the shrunk counterexample is archived in full rather than only summarized

the mutation gate neuters a rejection or threshold in an ephemeral copy only, requires the named tests to fail there, requires the same tests to pass before the mutation, and proves the repository file was left byte-identical
a mutation that fails to apply exactly once is reported as an indeterminate probe instead of a pass
the gate reports PASS, FAIL or INCOMPLETE and exits 0, 1 or 2, so an exhausted time limit or a missing report can never read as a green run

the summary records the generator version, the case schema version, every seed, the per-suite case count, the corpus digest and the measured duration, and the gate refuses a corpus smaller than the committed minimum

quarantine entries carry an owner, an expiry date and a reason; an expired entry, a blank owner or reason, a quarantined test that no longer exists, a quarantined test that currently passes, or a quarantined run that cannot be audited all stop the gate, and no phase is ever retried
the scheduled workflow publishes the machine-readable summary and names the software-only evidence class without claiming hardware or physical validation
no production module, interface schema, contract model or firmware source is modified by this change
commands: python3 tools/scripts/quality_gates.py mutation --registry tools/qa/mutations-v1.json --quarantine tools/qa/quarantine-v1.json --archive runs/qa/mutation-gate/summary.json
evidence: Task Packet schema validation output with exit code
targeted pytest output listing the collected Issue #89 property test names, pass counts and exit codes
property-gate summary JSON showing the generator version, case schema version, seeds, per-suite case counts, corpus digest and measured duration, with exit code 0
mutation-gate summary JSON showing each mutation, its applied offset, the control result, the mutated result, the named failing tests and exit code 0
a registry entry whose literal does not occur exactly once reported as indeterminate rather than as a caught mutation
an expired quarantine entry stopping the gate, a stale quarantine entry for a passing test stopping the gate, and a quarantine entry for a non-existent test stopping the gate
a gate run whose budget is exhausted reported as INCOMPLETE with exit code 2
a deliberately neutered assertion in a sandbox copy producing a FAIL summary with exit code 1
diff output proving every repository file named in read_only_paths is unchanged after the probes
ruff check, ruff format --check, the full pytest run, make contract, make scenario-check, make golden-check, make context-check and make docs output with exit codes
final git diff --check and git diff --name-only output proving every changed path is allowed
stop_conditions: Meeting the acceptance requires adding a dependency, editing a production module, or editing an interface schema, contract model or firmware source.
A probe can only be run by mutating the working tree instead of an ephemeral copy.
A missing summary, an unapplied mutation or an exhausted budget is reported as PASS instead of INCOMPLETE or FAIL.
A quarantined test is retried rather than reported.
A property suite is made to pass by weakening the assertion instead of fixing the boundary it tests.
data_classification: internal; the suites and summaries use synthetic event ids, synthetic entity names, synthetic waypoint names and synthetic CAN bytes, and read no real robot, camera, credential or operator data
model_policy: no model call; case generation, shrinking, mutation application and gate evaluation are deterministic
risks_and_fallbacks: A property test with no shrink step reports a 200-element noise case that nobody can debug. Failing cases are shrunk greedily before they are archived, and the summary keeps the minimal counterexample.

Imports of the editable install escape the sandbox copy and a probe silently tests the unmutated file. The gate rewrites sys.meta_path inside the sandbox, asserts every target module resolves under the sandbox root before running, and aborts when a module escapes.

A mutation probe written into the working tree could be left behind by an interrupted run. Probes are applied only inside a throwaway copy under the temporary directory, and the gate additionally hashes the read-only repository files before and after and reports any difference.
A gate that reports PASS when it could not run is worse than no gate. Missing inputs, an exhausted budget and an unapplied mutation all report INCOMPLETE with a non-zero exit.
Quarantine is an escape hatch that can silently swallow regressions. An entry needs an owner, a future expiry and a reason, and a quarantined test that is no longer failing fails the gate as stale.

Adding a scheduled workflow touches CI configuration, which AGENTS.md routes to integration review. The workflow is additive, uses pinned actions, requests contents: read only and gates on the same commands that run locally; the change is called out for reviewer attention.

The mutation registry names production files in read_only_paths even though the probes edit those files. The edits exist only inside an ephemeral copy that is deleted afterwards, nothing is committed from it, and the gate proves the repository copy is byte-identical; firmware and robot control are excluded from the registry entirely.
A large generated corpus can make the default test run slow. Each suite declares a case budget, the measured duration is recorded in the summary, and the suites stay in the unit-test time budget.
